strings.logCrlOk: Ibhokisi yesitshixo icocekile — akukho ziqinisekiso ezirhoxisiweyo

strings.hintAdd: Yongeza igama lepakethe ukufihla isazisi sesixhobo kuyo. Umzekelo: com.netflix.mediaclient
strings.hintLog: Wonke umyalelo usongelwe ngexesha lokuvala - isixhobo asinakuze sikhe sibe ngumkhenkce. Ukubhala kuthintelwe kwifayile enye kuphela: /data/adb/tricky_store/target.txt
strings.demo: Imowudi yemboniso — akukho ngcambu kule festile (isampuli yedatha yokubonisa kuphela)
strings.footerTop: FALCON TRICKY · iqabane lika FALCON INTEGRITY FIX
strings.maintHint: Cinezela naliphi na iqhosha ukubonisa inkcazelo yalo epheleleyo.
strings.mdKbSmart: • I-Smart keybox landa: ijonga ibhokisi yezitshixo yangoku ngokuchasene noluhlu lokurhoxiswa lwe Google (CRL) kwaye izama imithombo emininzi de ifumane ibhokisi yezitshixo esebenzayo, ngogcino oluzenzekelayo kunye nokuphinda kuqalwe kwakhona kwe Google iinkonzo. Ibaleka kuyo yonke impompo kwaye ifuna i-intanethi (imizuzu eyi-1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox from network: downloads a keybox from the official repository (GitHub) and saves it to /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Needs internet and takes 1-3 minutes. Used when the smart fetch fails or when the keybox was changed manually.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP ukuxilongwa: ijonga iimodyuli ezifumanekayo zoBonelelo oluBonelelo kude, ihlola uguqulelo lwesatifikethi sobungqina be-TEE, kwaye ibonisa isixhobo se-KmInstallKeybox. Ayitshintshi nto — imbonakalo yesixhobo esicacileyo.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine khangela (funda-kuphela): ibonisa Widevine izikhombisi zenqanaba (L1/L3) ukusuka kwi-dumpsys, i-DRM (IDM) ubukho befayile yesitshixo, kunye neempawu zenkqubo ezinxulumeneyo. Ayilungiswanga nto kwaphela.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Fixes attestation issues when the automatic pass fails. Every run prints a clear success/failure line.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handles the hard cases and takes longer. A clear result appears at the end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Cwangcisa kwakhona GMS: icoca Play Store kwaye Google iinkonzo (GMS+GSF) idata kwaye uqalise isixhobo ngokuzenzekelayo. Ngobungqina obunenkani kuphela - ayikhe ichukumise iifoto okanye iifayile zakho.
strings.mdCertify: • Isiqinisekiso sokudlala: ijonga RKP imo yobungqina besatifikethi sesixhobo kwaye isete ngokutsha iimpawu zobungqina ukuba ziyafuneka. Ayichukumisi idatha yomsebenzisi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: fixes Google services framework (SOTER) issues related to device attestation. Used for some devices that rely on SOTER instead of Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Faka PIF: qhuba sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Isebenzisa ushicilelo lweminwe olukhethiweyo (lwendawo/phambili) kwaye ihlaziya pif.prop/pif.json iifayile. Isiphumo esicacileyo siyavela kwilog.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF khangela: ibonisa imo injini efakiweyo, iifayile zeminwe (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), kunye nelog. Jonga kuphela - ayitshintshi nto.
strings.mdCanary: • Uhlaziyo lweCanary: qhuba sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ilanda ukukhutshwa kweNjini yeCanary yamva nje ukuqinisekisa ukuhambelana neziqinisekiso ezinyanzelekileyo RKP (ngoFebruwari 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.hintKbSlots: Imodyuli ilawula i-slots ezimbini zebhokisi yezitshixo: eyona nto iphambili (ingcwele, ayisoze yacinywa) kunye neyesibini (i-backup). Le thebhu ibonisa ukuba yeyiphi i-slot esebenzayo, itshintsha ukhetho, okanye ikhuthaza isibini ukuya kwiprayimari kwisicelo esicacileyo - kunye ne-backups kunye nelog epheleleyo.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Ukuxilongwa kwemfezeko: ijonga TEE isitshixo sokungeniswa ngaphandle, inaliti yethala leencwadi ngaphakathi kwe-keystore2, ubume bokurhoxiswa (CRL), uluhlu lokhuselo kunye ne-RKP imo. Funda-kuphela - ayitshintshi nto.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Faka isicelo kwakhona:

• Uluhlu lokhuseleko lwakhiwe ngokutsha kulo lonke usetyenziso olufakiweyo.
• Umaleko wokuhambelana kwe-custom-ROM usetyenziswa kwakhona.
• Ibhokisi yezitshixo esebenzayo iphinda isetyenziswe.
• Google Play000#000000iqaliswa kwaye#00000iqaliswa kwakhona6#000000000/iinkonzo ziyaqalwa kwakhona ibhokisi yesitshixo engundoqo zange ichukunyiswe.

Qhubeka?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Izitshixo ze-keybox: ibonisa ubume beendawo zokubeka eziziiprayimari nezizisekondari kwaye itshintshe ukhetho phakathi kwazo. Eyokuqala (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) isoloko ikhuselwe kwaye ayize yosulwe.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Nyusa i-slot yesibini ukuya eprayimari:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml iba ngowona mxholo we-slot ophambili.
• Eyokuqala ekhoyo igcinwa njenge-backup ngaphambi kokutshintshwa.
• Akukho nto icinyiweyo — umsebenzi ubuyiselwa umva.

Qhubeka?

strings.dgE3b: Ukuba ayisebenzi: qalisa kwakhona isixhobo — kwaye ungayiqalisi ngesandla.

strings.dgE61: zonke iimodyuli ezifakiweyo (ukuqinisekisa ukuba akukho nto isusiweyo ngaphandle kwesizathu)

strings.confirmKbSmart:
I-Smart keybox landa (entsha kwi v3.17):

• Ijonga ibhokisi yezitshixo yangoku ngokuchasene noluhlu Google lokurhoxiswa (CRL).
• Izama imithombo emininzi de kufumaneke ibhokisi yesitshixo ecocekileyo.
• Ugcino oluzenzekelayo + iqala kwakhona #000006# iinkonzo. i-intanethi (imizuzu eyi-1-3). Qhubeka?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Landela ibhokisi yezitshixo kwi-intanethi:

• Khuphela ibhokisi yesitshixo esemthethweni kwaye uyiqinisekise.
• Ihlohlwe ngokusisigxina (ayizange ibuyelwe ekuqaleni).

⚠️ Ifuna i-intanethi (ukuya kumzuzu omnye). Qhubeka?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Ubonelelo ngokutsha RKP izitshixo:

• Akukho datha okanye iifayile zebhokisi yezitshixo zicinyiweyo.
• Qalisa kwakhona ifowuni emva koko.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Ulungiso olupheleleyo:

• Izibonelelo kwakhona RKP + iphinda iqale Google iinkonzo.
• Isixhobo siqalisa ngokuzenzekelayo (akukho nto icinyiweyo).

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Qala kwakhona Google iinkonzo:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — qalisa kwakhona.
• Akukho nto icinyiweyo kwaye AKUSAYI kukhutshelwa ngaphandle.
• Isixhobo siqalisa ngokuzenzekelayo.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Nyanzelisa unikezelo kwakhona (Umlingo oBomvu):

• Kwizixhobo ezingahoyiyo iqhosha elivuzayo.
• Isebenza nokuba izitshixo zisempilweni.
• Akukho datha icinyiweyo.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmCertify:
Nyanzelisa Play Store isatifikethi:

• Icima kuphela indawo yokugcina indawo yogcino — iakhawunti yakho ayichukunyiswanga.
• Qalisa kwakhona, emva koko uvule iVenkile.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER ukulungisa:

• Iphinda iqale ivendor.soter inkonzo.
• Icoca iSOTER idatha yomncedisi kuphela.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Faka umnwe (PIF):

• Iguqulela custom.pif.prop kwaye uyihlohle kwindlela yenjini.
• Ifuna ulayisho ngokutsha emva koko.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirmCanary:
Hlaziya iminwe yeminwe yeCanary:

• Khuphela iminwe yamva nje esemthethweni yeCanary ukusuka kwi-Google.
• Ingqamanisa isiziba sokhuseleko + iqale kwakhona Google iinkonzo (akukho kuzisula).

⚠️ Ifuna i-intanethi (1-3 imiz). Qhubeka?
